title: Climate controls & Koeppen classification
quote: Weather = one place and time; climate = 30-year average

boxes.title: Controls in India
items: Mainland **8 deg N-37 deg N**; Tropic of Cancer crosses ==**8 states**==, Mahi twice
Himalayas keep north India **3-8 deg C** warmer in winter
Cold currents make tropical west coasts arid
⚠ ==Distance from a river is not a control== (APPSC GS 2025)

boxes.title: Key world regions
items: **Hot deserts**: **15-30 deg**, western margins; cold currents
**Mediterranean**: **30-45 deg** west margins; ==winter rain==; Rome, Santiago, Cape Town, Perth
**China type**: east margin; SE USA
**Taiga**: largest land biome; ==**wide** annual range==; podzol
**Equatorial**: rain daily, richest diversity
**Thornthwaite** (**1931**): precipitation effectiveness

cards.title: Steppes
lines: Eurasia; Cold vs Dry Asia (APPSC G1 2022)

boxes.title: Extremes
items: Hottest: ==**Death Valley 56.7 deg C**== (not Al Aziziya)
Lowest: **Vostok -89.2 degC**; driest: **Atacama**
Wettest: **Mawsynram** (**1,187 cm**)
India: **Ganganagar** ~**50 deg C** (**1935**); **Dras -45 deg C**; driest **Ruyli, Jaisalmer**
